evidence_and_moments.method: scipy.integrate.quad over lam with z | lam integrated analytically

window_mass.method: scipy.integrate.quad over lam of the Gaussian z | lam probability

grid_mass_centered.note: Trapezoid integral of the stored centered grid versus the exact window probability.

grid_mass_noncentered.note: Trapezoid integral of the stored non-centered grid versus the exact window probability.

grid_noncentered.note: Density in (lam, xi) with z = exp(lam/2) xi; it includes the Jacobian exp(lam/2), so it integrates to 1 like the centered density.

notes.counters: Grid evaluations are display/validation work, not sampler calls; all counters are therefore zero.
notes.credible_levels: Not provided: HPD regions of the funnel depend on the parameterization and extend into the neck beyond the window.
notes.log_floor: Display grids store max(log density, log_floor), rounded to 4 decimals; cells at the floor have smaller true values.
notes.reference_only: Independent reference calculation for validation and display. It is never passed to a sampler, proposal construction or training set.

window.note: Fixed display windows (spec §9 discussion scene). The lam prior is broad and z is weakly constrained, so part of the posterior lies outside; mass_inside_* are exact window probabilities.
